plain_language_explanation.text: For reinforcement steel in structural and bridge works, the applicable Indian Standard is **IS 1786:2008** (Grade Fe 500D). Under the Ministry of Steel Quality Control Order (2020), all reinforcement steel bars must carry a valid **BIS ISI Mark**. Tensile and elongation tests must conform to **IS 1608 (Part 1)**, and bend/rebend tests must satisfy **IS 1599**.

spec_draft_export.title: Technical Specification for High Strength Deformed Steel Bars (Fe 500D)
spec_draft_export.draft_clause: All reinforcing steel for RCC and PSC structural components shall be Thermo-Mechanically Treated (TMT) high strength deformed bars of Grade Fe 500D conforming strictly to IS 1786:2008 (incorporating Amendments 1 to 3). All supplied rebars must bear the BIS Standard Mark (ISI Mark) under a valid CM/L license issued by the Bureau of Indian Standards in compliance with the Steel and Steel Products (Quality Control) Order. The contractor shall submit manufacturer test certificates (MTC) verifying yield strength (≥ 500 N/mm²), tensile strength ratio (TS/YS ≥ 1.10), elongation (≥ 16.0%), and bend/rebend tests per IS 1599 and IS 1608 (Part 1) for every consignment batch before incorporation into work.
